verdict.rationale: Teams integrates Microsoft 365 Copilot for natural-language interaction with work data and Graph, and supports agent slash commands, both suggesting some AI-native command capability, but the evidence is generic (M365 Copilot overview, not Teams-specific hands-on detail) and mostly developer/agent-building oriented rather than end-user NL command usage. missing for 10: Teams-specific documentation/demo of end-users issuing natural-language commands to Copilot inside Teams, independent verification of this working, and detail on scope/limits of NL command coverage.
